primitives.name: Settled Game Log Completeness
primitives.verbatim_quote: Find which settled 2026 NFL regular-season games (Weeks 1-5 plus Week 6 TNF SEA@DEN, commenceTime >= 2026-09-01 and < 2026-10-17, mergedIntoGameId IS NULL) exist in `games` and which exist in `team_game_logs`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'G': 'set of settled games', 'L': 'set of logged games in team_game_logs'}
primitives.assumptions: All games within time window are either logged or missing; no duplicate or malformed entries.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Temporal exclusion of merged games and post-October 17th games.

layer2.mapping: Each game g ∈ G maps to a boolean indicator in L; completeness is binary.
layer2.telemetry: Count of |G ∩ L| vs |G| to compute coverage ratio.

primitives.name: Rest Day Validation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Inspect the 14 Week 6 NFL `games` rows and their current `restDaysAway` and `restDaysHome`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'r_h': 'restDaysHome for home team', 'r_a': 'restDaysAway for away team'}
primitives.assumptions: Rest days are computed as integer days since last game; no external scheduling conflicts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Validation of r_h and r_a values against expected ranges for each team.

layer2.mapping: Kernel function K(r_h, r_a) encodes team readiness; used in edgeScore computation.
layer2.telemetry: Mean deviation of r_h/r_a from league average per team.

primitives.name: Edge Score Evaluation
primitives.verbatim_quote: How should they be evaluated to find genuine positive-edge plays over de-vigged consensus odds?
primitives.assumptions: Edge score E = P - O; all probabilities normalized to [0,1]; no market inefficiency assumed.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Evaluation threshold E > 0.02 for actionable picks.

layer2.mapping: Edge score E is derived from P(O|data) - O; conforms to Bayesian posterior probability.
layer2.telemetry: Distribution of E across 5 remaining games; count of E > 0.02.
